sentences.en: The actress said that she was engaged to a banker.
sentences.zh: 那位女演员说她与一位银行家订婚了。

sentences.en: Investment bankers are tearing their hair out over the crash.
sentences.zh: 投资银行家们对这场崩溃感到束手无策、焦虑万分。

sentences.en: I want to be a banker when I grow up.
sentences.zh: 我长大后想成为一名银行家。

phrases.zh: 投资银行家：从事投资银行业务的银行家。

senses.zh: 银行家，银行经理；银行业者，金融业者
